description_en: Queries the information about the configured delivery channels
description_zh: 查询设置的投递渠道信息
name: DescribeDeliveryChannels

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the delivery channels. Separate multiple delivery channel IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a delivery channel, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174253.html
parameters.help_zh:
投递渠道ID。多个投递渠道ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取投递渠道ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174253.html
parameters.name: delivery_channel_ids

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification.description_en:
Specifies whether to accept the configuration history of resources. When the configuration of a resource changes, Cloud Config delivers the configuration history to Object Storage Service (OSS), Simple Log Service (SLS), or Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS). Valid values:
true: Accept the configuration history of resources.
false: Do not accept the configuration history of resources
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification.description_zh:
是否接收资源配置变更历史。当资源配置变更时，配置审计向对象存储OSS、日志服务SLS或轻量消息队列（原 MNS）投递资源配置变更历史。取值：
true：接收资源配置变更历史。
false：不接收资源配置变更历史

ConfigurationSnapshot.description_en:
Specifies whether to receive scheduled resource snapshots. Cloud Config delivers scheduled resource snapshots to OSS at 00:00:00 and 12:00:00 every day. Valid values:
true: Receive scheduled resource snapshots.
false: Do not receive scheduled resource snapshots
ConfigurationSnapshot.description_zh:
是否接收资源定时快照。每天00:00:00和12:00:00，配置审计定时向对象存储OSS投递资源定时快照。取值：
true：接收资源定时快照。
false：不接收资源定时快照

DeliveryChannelAssumeRoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role assumed by the delivery channel

DeliveryChannelCondition.description_en:
The additional rules for the delivery channel. Only MNS delivery channels support this parameter.

You can specify the minimum risk level and resource types for MNS event subscriptions as follows:

Minimum risk level for subscribed events: `{"filterType":"RuleRiskLevel","value":"1","multiple":false}`.

   The value field indicates the risk level to filter. Valid values: 1 for high risk, 2 for medium risk, and 3 for low risk.

Resource types for subscribed events: `{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`.
  
  The values field indicates the resource types for which you want to subscribe to events. It is a JSON array of resource types.

  Example: `[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`
DeliveryChannelCondition.description_zh:
投递渠道附加规则。当前仅MNS类型的投递渠道支持该参数。

您可以指定MNS订阅事件的最低风险等级和资源类型，具体如下：

订阅事件的最低风险等级为：`{"filterType":"RuleRiskLevel","value":"1","multiple":false}`。

   value表示您需要过滤的风险等级。取值：1表示高风险，2表示中风险，3表示低风险。

订阅事件的资源类型为：`{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`。
  
  values表示您需要订阅事件的资源类型，是一个资源类型的JSON数组。

  例如：`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`

DeliveryChannelId.description_en: The ID of the delivery channel

DeliveryChannelName.description_en: The name of the delivery channel

DeliveryChannelTargetArn.description_en:
The ARN of the destination for the delivery channel.

If DeliveryChannelType is OSS, this parameter indicates the ARN of the bucket.

If DeliveryChannelType is MNS, this parameter indicates the ARN of the topic.

If DeliveryChannelType is SLS, this parameter indicates the ARN of the Logstore
DeliveryChannelTargetArn.description_zh:
投递渠道目标地址的ARN。

当DeliveryChannelType为OSS时，该参数为Bucket的ARN。

当DeliveryChannelType为MNS时，该参数为Topic的ARN。

当DeliveryChannelType为SLS时，该参数为Logstore的ARN

DeliveryChannelType.description_en:
The type of the delivery channel. Valid values:
OSS: Object Storage Service (OSS). 
MNS: Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS).
SLS: Simple Log Service (SLS)
DeliveryChannelType.description_zh:
投递渠道类型。取值：
OSS：对象存储。 
MNS：轻量消息队列（原 MNS）。
SLS：日志服务

Description.description_en: The description of the delivery channel

NonCompliantNotification.description_en:
Specifies whether to accept resource non-compliance events. When a resource is evaluated as non-compliant, Cloud Config delivers the non-compliance event to SLS or Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS). Valid values: 
true: Accept resource non-compliance events.
false: Do not accept resource non-compliance events
NonCompliantNotification.description_zh:
是否接收资源不合规事件。当资源不合规时，配置审计向日志服务SLS或轻量消息队列（原 MNS）投递资源不合规事件。取值： 
true：接收资源不合规事件。
false：不接收资源不合规事件

OversizedDataOSSTargetArn.description_en: The ARN of the OSS bucket where oversized delivery data is stored when the data exceeds the limit of the delivery channel
OversizedDataOSSTargetArn.description_zh: 当投递数据超过投递渠道限制时，投递数据转存到对象存储OSS的目标存储空间

Status.description_en:
The status of the delivery setting. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
Status.description_zh:
投递设置状态。取值：
0：关闭。
1：开启
